posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked: There are no official registerable times to play. However, we will have a much larger booth, and will have room to fit at least 5 games of Sentinels very comfortably with plenty of chair space etc. There are also some games in the Gen Con game library from last year, and we might donate a few more this year if the demand is there, so between those and people's personal copies, I suspect that it will be pretty easy to get a game going in the free play area as well.
